rule_level_problems.problem: This rule merges the red-box severe anal signs with the outside-box 'anal sex + anal bleeding/pain/discharge'. It is acceptable because the urgent rule uses the severe findings directly rather than active_condition Proctitis, so non-urgent proctitis does not trigger Urgent.

summary: The most consequential miss is in the red-box 'at risk of severe disease' bullet: age > 65 (concept 'Age more than 65 years' exists) and 'HIV not on ART' are not encoded, so those patients are not flagged Urgent. The shock footnote has no probable-shock rule, and the outside 'mpox is more likely' statement has no probable-mpox rule. Dehydration and myocarditis fire on any single sign, and several differential rules (chickenpox stages, measles and tick-bite-fever spread patterns, shingles band, impetigo honey colour) lose their discriminating detail. The remaining red-box items are encoded correctly.
